scripts.dev: concurrently -n daemon,web -c blue,magenta 'cd packages/daemon && bun run dev' 'cd packages/web && bun run dev'
scripts.start: bun run build && concurrently -n daemon,web -c blue,magenta 'cd packages/daemon && bun run start' 'cd packages/web && bun run start'
scripts.test: bun test packages/shared packages/daemon/tests packages/cli/tests packages/web/tests
